core.title: Solid Black Privacy Door Knob Set, Acorn SC4BI
tags: Smooth black Iron door knob sets

text.description_html:
Acorn SC4BI, Black Privacy Half Round Knob

Please Click Here To Order

Door knobs with a solid black finish are not easy to find especially of this quality. Good for both exterior and interior use, it is easy to install and has a lifetime no-rust warranty. A privacy knob, this smooth black iron knob is for doors that could need locking for privacy such as bathroom or bedroom doors. Made by Acorn, it will fit standard pre-drilled doors with either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets with 1-3/4" or 1-3/8" door thickness.

Privacy Set (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior knob engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior knob.

Features and Specifications of Smooth Iron Door Knob Set:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Projection: 2-9/16"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Backset: 2-3/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" or 1-3/8"
  • Latch: 1"
  • Reversible tubular latch.
  • Fits standard pre-drilled doors with 2-1/8" crossbores and 15/16 edgebores.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually. Package includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
